summary: Same-Session Final Reconciliation Gate: Final Snapshot Reconciliation v4 now requires the strict 20:00+ Finviz candidate to belong to the same ET trading date as the reconciliation run. A stale prior-session candidate is explicitly blocked instead of producing a misleading new final artifact. Runtime Final Authority accepts only v4 + nearest-timestamp policy + same-session date verification + at least two independent sources for price/change outcome labels. Final AH volume remains training-blocked. No scoring or threshold retune.
